title: The VikRentCar Car Rental Management System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the…
description: The VikRentCar Car Rental Management System plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'optionals' parameter. This vulnerability affects all versions up to and including 1.4.10. It allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when users access the affected pages.
